dialogue_texts: Out with it, Saika! Who's the second one spreading this glohm around?
But still, we shouldn't go in until the other's dealt with.
When we have a glohmed maid, all our wishes come true.
Berenice is the one who gave us her.
What's going on? Has she recovered from her injuries?
Why are you asking me that question? I can't answer that.
It's as if some cheap shadow could catch me.
I'm cleanin' up this stage, and you're first on the list!
There will always be ways for us to outsmart you.
She never succeeded in locking me up...
And I escaped before that witch laid a finger on me.
Tell us the truth, or else.
